title: KAITO — Happy Anniversary! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone, thank you so much for coming to my anniversary show today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow! What a cheer. I can feel the energy all the way up here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And those of you watching the stream, thank you for being here and for all your comments. Your support means so much to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll sing my heart out to make this a great day for each and every one of you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll all enjoy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, it sounds like everyone is ready.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then let's get started.
My first song is one you all know and love!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you all for listening!
We're starting things off with so much energy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Actually, I have some friends here ready to help me on stage today. And here they are.
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, everyone! I'm glad to see you're all feeling warmed up already!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good work out there, KAITO! Your solo song was amazing♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You all looked like you were having such a great time, we just had to smile!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll do everything we can to make this an unforgettable show, so let's all celebrate KAITO's anniversary together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you! I really put my all into planning for today, so I hope you'll keep enjoying yourselves to the end.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you worked really hard making the set list, huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I sure did. I picked each song thinking of what I most want to convey to everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of my set list... Did you all see the videos I posted on the 14th and the 16th? Those are actually hints as to what's coming up.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hints?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right. The video on the 14th was me dancing without music, and the video on the 16th was me doing a certain song's call and response...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did you all figure out which songs those were?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow, listen to that! So many of you got my hints!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I'm glad you enjoyed watching my videos, too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO! Look at the stream comments!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone's saying they were happy for the surprise, and that they picked up on your hints instantly!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone here in the venue answered right away too... They all must really love listening to your songs, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... That makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for always listening to me sing, everyone! I hope to convey my gratitude to you all the best way I know how—through my songs.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Up next, we have the two songs I hinted at! I hope you'll all enjoy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here we go! Start the music!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's all do this next dance together! Don't worry, it's simple and fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Great, you all look fantastic! Let's finish up with the ending pose!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And you're all right on beat for the call and response! Did you practice with my video?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, I can't let you down!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here we go! Full throttle!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for all your energy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your support, and your well-wishes, have all reached me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hearing all your voices calling out to me makes me feel like my heart's on fire...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope this feeling of mine reached you through my songs... Did it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. It sounds like it did!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah, it does...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But it sounds like everyone has so much more to share.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well, so do we!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And with that... Time for our special messages to KAITO♪
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, KAITO! You thought long and hard about how to make this show fun for everyone who's come to see you, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Seeing everyone here, and you, smiling so brightly really makes me happy too. Once again, happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, KAITO!
It looks like everyone enjoyed your surprise videos! That's so great!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And the call-and-response was perfect... I joined in nice and loud, too! Hehehe. I'm so happy I get to celebrate with you and everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm really happy I can help pump up your anniversary show, too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And it gives me such a warm feeling, seeing everyone cheer for you and knowing how loved you are. Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, KAITO.
Thank you for always watching over us all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whenever you need help, we'll be there for you. All you need to do is ask.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Happy anniversary! Today's show has been so fantastic. You made it one for everyone to be a part of, and so uniquely you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's keep on singing and dancing together, and bringing our feelings to everyone! Happy anniversary, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay everyone, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! On my cue! One, two, three...!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you so much, everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I did a lot of thinking about how to make this show rewarding for everyone who's always cheering me on.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Truth be told, before I stepped on stage, I was nervous about whether you'd actually enjoy it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that anxiety was blown away when I saw your faces.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Seeing you all smile because of my singing... I realized once more just how happy that makes me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So please, let me say thank you. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for listening to me sing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope today's show has helped my gratitude reach you all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm sure it did.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. I think those cheers say it all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you so much, everyone. I truly am glad.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, let's finish up strong! I'll sing with the strength your support gives me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, everyone, I'll be counting on all of you until the end!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just leave it to us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll sing from the heart until the very end, for all of you to hear. Here we go, everyone!
